name: vqa_diagnostics_v3
purpose: P1 diagnose C learning bottleneck; P2 compare local/bulk one-step updates from an identical learned nonempty A state. Exploratory development experiments, not new clinical or heldout confirmation.
reused_data: v2 train/selection/anchor only; never v1/v2 report. P1 first24 C train, all24 C selection and all24 B selection; P2 both24 B train batches, B selection24 and A anchor24.

fresh_development_review.source_role: unused h_search explicitly reserved dev_review only
fresh_development_review.selection: seeded metadata-only global matching,12/type; exclude all prior memberships and pixels; freeze membership before target association

model: same frozen Qwen2.5-VL-7B BF16 SDPA temperature0 max2048 answer512
memory: raw10 abstract2 top2; skills off, frozen original prompts/retrieval except declared P1 diagnostic interventions

initial_states.P1: empty and fixed v2 Local-0 after B, chosen as the state that reached C
initial_states.P2: v2 Bulk after A, raw10/abstract2, fixed exploration starting point; chosen with knowledge of previous report, not an independent confirmation. No checkpoint search.

p1.proposal: Generate once from after_B on frozen first24 C train; preserve every train interaction trace, final proposal and local candidates. Raw-only intervention keeps previous abstract bank. Same proposal for all memory variants.
p1.lexical: Force up to2 proposal raw records sourced ONLY from the24 C training examples, rank by visible-question token Jaccard; ties memory_id. No evaluation answers/type metadata used for retrieval. Diagnostic intervention, not claimed automatic method.
p1.contract: Append output instruction and allowed 3x3 region tokens derived solely from first24 C training labels. No target labels, sample-specific answers or new scoring normalization. Treat missing question/target as audit flags, not usable supervision for instruction design.
p1.quality_rule: Question empty/nan/null/none OR target empty/nan/null is flagged from source fields before inference. Target none remains legitimate. Keep all24 in native primary denominator; separately report flag-free subset.
p1.choose: Among local_raw,bulk_raw,bulk_raw_train_only_lexical,bulk_raw_train_only_lexical_contract require net correct gain>=2 on both all24 and flag-free selection subsets versus after_B; format1.0. Max all24 correct then fixed listed order. Empty state is a context diagnostic, not an eligible fix.
p1.review: Only after choice, evaluate after_B and chosen condition on untouched24 C dev_review. No selection by review. If none qualifies, keep review unopened for inference and fail promotion.
p1.promotion: Selection conditions above plus positive native and flag-free review gain. Exploratory engineering gate, not statistical significance.
p1.image_dependence: Fixed after_B state on B selection24, true images vs predetermined cyclic shift by one. Labels/questions/memory same; retain all denominators. Diagnostic only; no claims from all-zero outcomes.
p1.no_selection_optimization: No configuration or thresholds changed after outputs; no report sample used.

p2.design: Two independent one-step B update blocks, both reset to identical H_A. Each uses one of the frozen v2 B train24 batches and generates one shared proposal. Not a sequential B trajectory.
p2.gate: B selection24+A anchors24, recompute common reference; current correct+1,score>0,format1; B0 lost old correct0 without recovery offset, Binf removes hard constraint. Same prediction reused for two budgets; tie current correct,then fewer old losses,then fixed scope index.
p2.occupancy: Common raw10/abstract2 full bank; local up to2raw replacements and1abstract role, bulk full bank, no expansion. Record kept/replaced/new counts, selected-memory counts and context length. Abstract role main_policy in block1, failure_avoidance in block2.
p2.review: Baseline empty A dev_review24 identifies newly gained G_A in H_A; commonH_A A/B review24 each; chosen state for each of4 policies evaluated on same48 review cases, identical selected states evaluated once. Choice never uses review outcomes.
p2.primary_mechanism: For each block require G_A_review nonempty, Local0 accepted B gain on selection and positive independent B review gain, zero G_A_review loss; BulkInf accepted with anchor loss>0 and Bulk0 rejects for historical budget. Report both blocks whether passed or failed; replicated mechanism only if both pass.
p2.gate_attribution: Local0 versus LocalInf differences disclosed; equality does not support extra hard-budget benefit.
p2.scope: Only A->B common-state mechanism now. A/B->C common-state experiment deferred until P1 yields C learning; no unbudgeted followup.

statistics: Exact paired4cells and McNemar sensitivity for all changes; descriptive effect sizes, single seed and two correlated development blocks. No confirmatory superiority claims or patient independence. No post-hoc change to v2 frozen gates.
execution: Two independent workers; P1 launched first, P2 common-A->B does not depend on C repair and can run alongside it. One root/clock/8000 total cap. Stop siblings on fatal error, no automatic restart, no new report-set claims.
failure: Preserve all outputs and original clock; model/guard failures stop allowned workers. Finite-data missing flags not silently dropped or relabeled. No diagnostic promotion on floor-effect or semantic F1 alone.
